capabilities: render a vowel diagram from a vowel-chart code block
position vowels by coordinates, keywords, or IPA symbols
place labeled dots left or right of a position
choose chart layout (trapezoid, triangle, square, formant)
configure chart size and low-vowel positioning
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and includes manual installation instructions copying files into the plugins folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render a vowel chart showing a language's vowel inventory inside a note.
summary: Renders IPA vowel diagrams from code blocks, placing vowels by coordinates, keywords, or IPA position.
